values./system/biography: A powerful feral ghoul in a ruined Nuka-World uniform, carrying a locket inscribed to Zee.
values./items/@6a2a2586dbf9fb08/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@2ab190f39dc515a0/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@4b20c659d25dfffc/system/descript: M. Walker cannot be influenced by Speech and attacks the nearest enemy.
values./items/@4502a26910875bc4/system/descript: M. Walker regains 1 HP per 3 Radiation damage prevented.
values./items/@57a48ff751bb323b/system/descript: An Unarmed attack after moving into Reach gains Stun; on a miss M. Walker falls prone.
